tools.name: search_esim_plans
tools.description: Use this when someone needs mobile data for a trip and wants eSIM options. Pass the destination (country name in any common spelling, a 2-letter country code, or a region such as Europe, Asia or Global) and the trip length in days. Returns plans on sale now, cheapest first, with the USD price charge

tools.name: get_plan_details
tools.description: Use this when the traveler asks about one plan from search_esim_plans: every country it covers, data, validity, calls or texts, how the eSIM is delivered and topped up. Pass the plan id.

tools.name: check_device_compatibility
tools.description: Use this when the traveler asks whether their phone or tablet can use an eSIM, or before they buy if the device is unclear. Pass the model as they wrote it, e.g. 'iPhone 12', 'Galaxy S21', 'Pixel 7a'. Returns supported, likely, not_supported or unknown, with the reason and how to confirm on the devi

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description: Use this when the traveler has picked a plan and wants to buy it. Pass the plan id. Returns a simabroad.com link; the traveler opens it and pays there (card, Apple Pay or Google Pay). This tool charges nothing and needs no personal details.
